_metadata.description: Per-node bounded concurrency with fair scheduling; mirrors test-genie one-run-per-scenario discipline.

requirements.title: Per-Node Job Queue & Scheduling
requirements.description: Each node runs at most one job at a time (or a small bounded concurrency), with queued jobs scheduled fairly and surfaced in the control plane, mirroring test-genie's one-run-per-scenario discipline so a gate run never thrashes a node.

validation.notes: A second job for a busy node queues rather than running concurrently beyond the node's bound; ordering is fair.
Queued and running jobs are visible per node in the control plane with accurate state transitions.
